body:
ListPropsScreen's category order editor (A9) uses IconButton up/down
controls to reorder categories rather than a real drag gesture. This
satisfies A9's acceptance criteria (the persisted order is a correct
LWW edit) and the Notes' functional requirement, but not the literal
"drag-reorder" wording in the original ticket text.

Upgrading to real drag would need Compose's pointerInput + offset
tracking (or a reorderable-list library), which is a distinct, fairly
involved piece of work — deliberately deferred rather than gold-plated
into A9.

Low priority: the current buttons are fully functional, just less
fluid UX than drag would be.
title: Category order editor: replace up/down buttons with real drag-reorder
